A desktop-style bar of menus with one highlight that slides between open menus and instant switching as you sweep across.
Block page scrolling and outside clicks while a menu is open.
Closes the open menu and returns focus to its trigger.
Corner radius of the bar. Triggers and the highlight derive theirs from it.
Disable a single menu with `disabled` on <l1/>, or the whole bar on <l2/>. Arrow keys skip disabled menus.

Each <l0/> is a Dropdown menu, so items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, labels and shortcuts work and look exactly the same. Open a menu, then move the pointer or press the arrow keys to sweep across the bar.
Give the menubar a name with `aria-label`. It renders `role="menubar"` and each trigger is a menu item, so screen readers announce it as an application menu.

`MenubarItem`, `MenubarCheckboxItem`, `MenubarRadioGroup`, `MenubarRadioItem`, `MenubarGroup`, `MenubarLabel`, `MenubarSeparator`, `MenubarShortcut`, `MenubarSub`, `MenubarSubTrigger` and `MenubarSubContent` are the Dropdown menu parts with `menubar-*` slots. See the Dropdown menu API for their props.
`orientation="vertical"` stacks the menus and switches navigation to the up and down arrows. Open the menus to the side with `side="inline-end"`.
